title: THE CHIP THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING
subtitle: A procedural documentary about the hidden semiconductor supply chain

beats.text: Almost every advanced computer depends on a supply chain most people never see.
beats.label: THE HIDDEN SYSTEM

beats.text: The story is not just about the chip. It is about the specialized machines, factories and organizations behind it.
beats.label: THE SUPPLY CHAIN

beats.text: Think of the process as four linked stages: design, fabrication, packaging and distribution.
beats.label: FOUR STAGES

beats.text: Those stages are spread across countries, companies and facilities that depend on one another.
beats.label: A GLOBAL NETWORK

beats.text: The balance of power changed over decades as specialization made the industry faster, more capable and more concentrated.
beats.label: DECADES OF SPECIALIZATION

beats.text: That concentration is the real story: a disruption in one obscure part of the chain can ripple through the entire technology economy.
beats.label: THE BOTTLENECK

beats.text: This is how a component most people never notice can become one of the most strategically important systems on Earth.
beats.label: THE THESIS
